title: Hillarys SSW (shore effects)
assumptions: Mike (2026-11-09, laps north of Hillarys Boat Harbour): 20 to 25 mph SSW, 2 to 3 ft. Wind from 202 deg, waves toward 22 deg +-20 deg, period 4.1 s (20 kt over 20 km, the evening Doctor seas' fetch), at 0.8, 1 and 1.25 times.
Open water upwind (SSW) is taken as unshadowed at the window edge; the WA DoT 5 m survey in the pack at 30 m cells, so the harbour walls are blobs a cell or two wide.
Breakwall reflection R = 0.4 (rock rubble mound, a guess); the beach absorbs (R = 0.1). No tide, current or wind regrowth in the lee; the local fetch shelter still comes from the fetch map.
